# Current bundled producer records

These examples were emitted by the bundled Python producers with compact synthetic inputs. Network producers use the transports from their tests; no external submissions were made. IQ-TREE recovery captures a failed publication and rollback. Sanger draft input includes native signal bounds. The protocol producer-format test checks the original key order, whitespace and final newline.

BLAST receipts are captured for the next type conversion; the other JSON files are covered by the test. These describe current formats only.
